chapter_access: GET /study-data/v1/chapters/GEN/01.json and read .verses["GEN.1.1"].ASV1901; each chapter includes the available four editions of word-link evidence
external_resources: Actual edition Bible chapter text comes from translation-specific repositories
Noah Webster 1828 historical dictionary remains an independent English dictionary resource
Commentary content is owned by its separate future research sources
lexicon_lookup_calculation: index=(id_number-1)//250; first=index*250+1; last=min(first+249, H:8674 or G:5624); pad first,last to 5 digits
no_verse_level_http_object_required: Each chapter contains directly keyed verse objects, so a cached chapter answers any verse in that chapter and permits instant edition switching of its link evidence.

source_kinds.ASV1901: supported exact KJV-derived zero-based English target token index
source_kinds.BSB: native original language table row NOT English word index
source_kinds.KJV1769: native tagged USFM word ordinal NOT English full verse token index
source_kinds.WEBSTER1833: supported exact KJV-derived zero-based English target token index

unlinked_words: Do not invent association where no link exists. Direct English dictionary lookup is separate and optional.
versioning: Data files in this immutable v1 path must not be modified in place after installation; issue v2 for corrected release
